notes.areas: Area A: Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Delhi, Faridabad complex, Ghaziabad, Greater Mumbai, Gurgaon, Hyderabad, Kanpur, Kolkata, Lucknow, Nagpur, Navi Mumbai, Noida, Pune, Secunderabad. Area B: about 85 other cities including Coimbatore, Madurai, Tiruchirappalli, Salem, Tiruppur, Erode (Tamil Nadu), Agra, Bhopal, Chandigarh, Indore, Jaipur, Kochi, Patna, Surat, Vadodara, Visakhapatnam. notes.monthly: Daily rate x 26 working days = monthly minimum. Hourly rate = daily rate / 8.
notes.revision: VDA is revised twice a year, from 1 April and 1 October, on the average Consumer Price Index for Industrial Workers (CPI-IW).

provenance.read_method: OCR of the official scanned PDF (RapidOCR/onnxruntime, 150 DPI, 21 Nov 2026) — the PDF carries no text layer (pypdf extracts 1,915 chars from 30 pages). Every total below was read as an explicit 'basic+VDA=total' sum printed in the order.
provenance.scope_note: CENTRAL SPHERE ONLY: these rates apply where the Central Government is the 'appropriate Government' (railways, mines, oilfields, banks, establishments under central authority, and contractors supplying workers to them). A private shop, restaurant, clinic or factory in a state follows THAT STATE's minimum wages — Tamil Nadu state rates are NOT in this file (the TN Labour Department's G.O. PDFs return 404; see LIMITATIONS.md L18/L39).
provenance.source: Labour Bureau, Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India
provenance.verification: All totals cross-checked 21 Nov 2026 against three independent readings of the same order (factohr.com, shiftelio.com, in.scrolljob.org) — all agree. CPI-IW average 431.42 (base 2016=100), up 6.62 points from 424.80. VDA rounded up to the next rupee per the Minimum Wages Advisory Board.
